description: Ready for Anything Anywhere Get the mobility and flexibility you need to work anywhere on almost any surface with a mouse that’s small in size, but big on versatility and comfort. Enjoy switchable, dual-mode wireless connectivity, smooth, precise control, and a slim, portable design that contains recycled materials. * This HP mouse image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Wireless Connectivity Your Way Regardless of what OS you use , now you can connect quickly, easily, and with a new level of plug-and-play simplicity. For more device flexibility, switchable dual-mode wirelessconnectivity provides more options like USB-A dongle at 2.4GHz or Bluetooth 5.0+ standard. Freedom to Work Wherever Now you have the freedom to work virtually anywhere on virtually any surface. That’s because a multi-surface sensor technology enables mouse tracking on multiple surfaces while a 1600 DPI optical sensor delivers smooth, precise control. Plus, one AA battery can last up to 16 months.
